content.value_statement: Modern framework apps need App Hosting decisions, configuration, and Firebase CLI steps that are easy to mix up. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through deployment, secrets, emulation, and backend management.
actual_capabilities: Helps choose between Firebase Hosting and Firebase App Hosting for static, SPA, SSR, and ISR apps.
Guides source deployments using firebase.json, apphosting.yaml, and Firebase CLI deploy steps.
Explains App Hosting runConfig settings for CPU, memory, instances, and concurrency.
Shows how to define build and runtime environment variables with Secret Manager-backed secrets.
Covers local App Hosting emulation with emulator-specific overrides and localhost serving behavior.
Summarizes CLI commands for backends, rollouts, automated GitHub deployment, and secrets management.
limitations: Does not create a Firebase project or upgrade billing without user action.
Does not replace Firebase authentication, IAM checks, or project permission review.
Focuses on App Hosting and does not cover every Firebase product architecture.
CLI examples require npm, firebase-tools, and authenticated Firebase access.

use_cases.title: Deploy a Framework App
use_cases.description: Plan and run an App Hosting deployment for a Next.js or Angular app that needs server rendering.

use_cases.title: Tune Runtime Configuration
use_cases.description: Set CPU, memory, scaling, concurrency, environment variables, and secrets for an App Hosting backend.

use_cases.title: Choose a Hosting Workflow
use_cases.description: Compare Firebase Hosting, App Hosting source deployment, and GitHub-connected automated deployment.

prompt_templates.title: Choose the Hosting Option
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner planning for a new Firebase app.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my app type, framework, and rendering needs. Tell me whether Firebase Hosting or Firebase App Hosting is the better fit, and explain the deployment path.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare App Hosting Files
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me prepare firebase.json and apphosting.yaml for my app. Include backend ID, root directory, runtime resources, environment variables, and secret references.

prompt_templates.title: Test Locally With Emulators
prompt_templates.prompt: Set up local App Hosting emulation for my project. Include emulator overrides, safe handling for local secret values, and checks I should run before deploying.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Automated Deployment
prompt_templates.prompt: Design an App Hosting workflow connected to GitHub. Cover backend creation, rollout strategy, branch or commit selection, secrets, and rollback considerations.

output_examples.input: I have a Next.js app and want to deploy it with Firebase App Hosting.
output_examples.output: The skill recommends App Hosting because the app can need server rendering. It outlines required configuration files, secret setup, billing prerequisites, and the final Firebase CLI deployment step.

output_examples.input: My App Hosting app needs an API key during runtime.
output_examples.output: The skill explains that the value should live in Cloud Secret Manager. It describes naming the environment variable, granting backend access, and avoiding committed local secret values.

output_examples.input: I want to test App Hosting locally before release.
output_examples.output: The skill describes using the Firebase Local Emulator Suite, optional emulator-specific overrides, and the default local App Hosting port for browser testing.

best_practices: Use Secret Manager references for sensitive values instead of committed plain text environment values.
Choose App Hosting when the app needs supported full-stack framework features such as SSR or ISR.
Validate configuration with the local emulator before deploying changes to production backends.
anti_patterns: Using App Hosting for a simple static site when Firebase Hosting is enough.
Committing emulator files that contain real API keys or other sensitive local values.
Running GitHub rollout commands when a project only needs direct Firebase CLI deployment.

faq.question: What does this skill help me deploy?
faq.answer: It helps deploy modern full-stack web apps, especially Next.js and Angular apps, with Firebase App Hosting.

faq.question: Can it decide between Firebase Hosting and App Hosting?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains when static hosting is enough and when App Hosting is better for SSR, ISR, or framework backends.

faq.question: Does it handle secrets?
faq.answer: It provides guidance for Secret Manager-backed App Hosting secrets and warns against committing sensitive local values.

faq.question: Can it help with local testing?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers App Hosting emulation, emulator override files, and the default local serving behavior.

faq.question: Does it require Firebase CLI access?
faq.answer: Yes. The deployment and management workflows assume npm, firebase-tools, and an authenticated Firebase project.

faq.question: Does it manage GitHub automated deployments?
faq.answer: It explains the relevant backend and rollout commands for GitHub-connected App Hosting workflows.
